name: forge-sedm
description: SEDM (Special Education Data Model) forge bundle — parses the SEDM CEDS-Map CSV + domain-structures JSON and emits the universal forge property contract (DmeClass/DmeProperty/DmeOptionSet/DmeOptionValue/DmeSupport roles, synthetic sedm:<kind>/<key> stableIds, P###### CEDS cross-refs stashed for later bridging, voyage embeddings). IDEA-compliance domain model layered over CEDS; standard-pure SEDM block, no cross-standard edges.
